description: This file defines a report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports in Odoo, including methods for processing account data, formatting output, and handling fiscal years.

classes.name: account_balance_landscape
classes.description: A report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports, with methods for processing account data, formatting, and calculations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and local context for report rendering.

methods.name: linesForYear
methods.description: Prepares year-wise data for the report, including formatting totals and extracting fiscal year names.

methods.name: linesForTotal
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit amounts for specified accounts and fiscal years.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Recursively retrieves account lines, including child accounts, with formatted balances and percentages.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Returns a list of fiscal years with their display names and indices.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Retrieves formatted account lines for a specific year, including balances and comparison patterns.

methods.name: cal_total
methods.description: Sets total debit and credit values based on accumulated results.
